brain_selected_panel.claim: Distinct source-corrected panel case study; post-review design, not original endpoint or external population replication
brain_selected_panel.panel: new selection from genuine brain RNA under the original motif/token/locus/detection rules

historical_panel_corrected_source.claim: Correct-source check conditional on the unchanged aortic-selected historical panel; no independent-panel claim

brain.feature_identity: Preserve all official unique versioned ENSG IDs; symbols are uniquified in the exact official feature order by standard make_index_unique(join="-") replay; no arbitrary suffix stripping or symbol aggregation. Normalize full universe before subsetting
brain.normalization: CP10k and log1p over all gene-expression features BEFORE panel selection/subsetting
brain.pairing: sample-level matching of separate nuclei; no same-cell pairing or verified donor uncertainty
brain.quota_rule: Per-type q_t=min(floor(128/number_of_common_types),minimum n[sample,assay,type] across both assays and every shared sample); one q_t per type, not a global scalar
brain.sample_rule: all exact shared sample IDs; metadata-defined types with at least 1 cell in every shared sample in both assays

design: Separately registered source correction and new-panel demonstration, never a silent rerun of the thirteen historical rows.
limits: Retained panel/source case study does not close causal regulation, independent model-level gate validation, donor uncertainty, or unknown training overlap.

models.budget_scope: 28800 seconds cumulative stage runtime across all contexts/readouts including resumes
models.exclusion_reason: Historical source-invalid knockout graphs retained as historical evidence; fresh knockout inference has not been registered by this bounded six-readout correction and cannot be replaced by embedding results

panel.detection_pool: Registered metadata-balanced genuine brain RNA selected cell pool; same pool supplies model and coexpression, so panel selection is not independent or held out
panel.overlap_reporting: original historical panel overlap explicit; never call gene-disjoint
panel.selection: coordinate first record; Geneformer token+positive median and scGPT vocabulary; at least one brain ATAC peak midpoint in half-open TSS-2kb through TES; genuine brain RNA detection>=.01; keep all passing JASPAR TFs then descending detection non-TFs with symbol tie-break; final sorted symbols

pbmc.metadata_na: Exclude blank, NA, nan and NaN cell types before hash selection; equal-weight accessibility mean over all named types represented in the frozen selected pool. Save absent original types explicitly
pbmc.pairing: same-cell exact complete barcode only; library-level case study; donor-independent CI not estimable
pbmc.selection: SHA256(seed:pbmc:barcode) ascending among exact RNA/ATAC/metadata common cells; no outcome selection
pbmc.source: existing paired 10x PBMC multiome local H5ADs and exact cell metadata
pbmc.source_identity_limit: Exact local RNA/ATAC barcode order establishes local split pairing; primary upstream processing-chain verification is separately recorded. Do not claim external source validation from this check alone

pilot.budget_scope: 3600 seconds cumulative across both panel pilots
pilot.panels: One batch of exact selected brain cells for EACH registered panel and each of six readouts; full inference requires both panels pass actual saved CPU/CUDA comparison

proxy.accessibility: equal cell-type mean of log1p mean raw ATAC count over registered selected cells
proxy.links: peak midpoint in strand-aware promoter+gene-body; no distal enhancement or paired RNA correlation
proxy.scope: motif-accessibility potential, not causal truth; no biological success classes

reason: Official GSM6593315 raw counts and complete candidate row naming replay reveal aortic RNA in the historical brain context. Withdraw biological interpretation of affected historical results; keep original files and multiplicity families intact.
registration_clarification: Metadata and expression-only clarification completed before any corrective prepare or model outcomes; original replication plan unchanged

statistics.baseline: Coexpression is absolute Pearson over full-library log1pCP10k on the exact model cell pool. Zero-variance gene rows/columns remain NaN. Primary incremental and comparable contrast statistics require every frozen TF-target coexpression pair finite, besides model pair coverage
statistics.budget_scope: 28800 seconds cumulative across all contexts and specifications per stage, including authorized resumes; invocation runtime persisted in budget state. Budget stop preserves prior receipts
statistics.comparison: same outcome,pairs and structural nuisance for FM and coexpression contrasts; incremental FM alignment additionally controls rank(coexpression)
statistics.draw_policy: Undefined draw stops, preserve checkpoint, never drop/redraw
statistics.family: all registered arm x tissue x readout x degree x null slots pooled IUT BY and Holm; unavailable frozen-pair rows retained as correction_input_p=1 not measured MC p
statistics.randomization_scope: Conditional diagnostics; empirical exchangeability remains unproven
statistics.restricted_rule: TF status x target locus peak-count quintile x gene-linked peak sequence GC tertile, using fixed quantile cuts over the entire selected panel. Unique quantile cuts keep ties together; no brain neural marker mask in corrective family; exclude self edges only. M relabels genes within these groups; D shuffles nonself target assignments independently within each TF row and group
statistics.rng: Same fixed seed across readouts in each context/specification; draws shared within exact job/degree/null; no adaptive changes or early significance stops
statistics.statistic: incremental partial Spearman rho(FM, proxy | target locus peak count, gene length, tissue-specific RNA detection, gene-linked peak GC, rank(coexpression), optional own proxy outdegree/indegree). Own degree recomputed for every draw; none omits both degree columns
